The minotaur {npc:Curos}, who leads the Zao orcs, is willing to accept help from humans, but only if you prove your worth. You kill a rebel orc leader and destroy the magic device the lizards use to spy on the orcs. You receive Tomes of Knowledge and gain access to Curos's daily tasks, which give experience and gold.
The leader of the Zao orcs, the minotaur Curos, accepts help from humans, but earning his trust won't be easy.
Curos, orc camp in the middle of the Zao steppe
Having completed the first 6 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
A melee weapon to break a wall
or a ready-made {item:Crocodile Steak}, for task 2
Curos gives you one at the end of mission 2; there are more in chests along the way (orc fort and top of the lizard tower)
Curos's daily tasks: between 800 and 1,800 experience and between 650 and 2,250 gold each
After the 2 missions from {npc:Curos} (The Wrath of the Kahn and The Maw of the Dragon).
A random task, each repeatable every 20 hours; they give between 800 and 1800 experience and between 650 and 2250 gold.
Do mission 2 at the same time as mission 7 (Messengers Of Peace) of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}: the route is the same and you save time.
In the lizard tower there is little room to run: go with full health and mana and kill the monsters on each floor one at a time.
1. Mission 1: The Wrath of the Kahn

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}. In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the mountain surface. Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe}. From there go **northeast** to the central orc camp.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe

Go to the orc camp in the centre of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}. The minotaur {npc:Curos} is in the **northeast** part of the camp. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}: you have to kill the rebel leader, the {creature:Renegade Orc}, in {wiki:Zao Orc Land} to the northwest.
Go to the **northwest** part of the Zao steppe, to {wiki:Zao Orc Land}. Follow the path along the mountain to the last ramp and go up.
Last ramp in the Zao Orc Land
Levitate up to the bamboo fort

Along the **east** side of the mountain look for a spot where you can levitate up. It is hidden under the floor above, but if you walk hugging the east side of the mountain you will see the spot. Use {spell:Levitate} (or parcels) to go up and follow the mountain until you are behind a bamboo fort.
Use Levitate here to reach the fort
Use your melee weapon on the damaged part of the wall until it breaks. Go through and down the stairs.
Break this wall to get in
Go **southwest** to the next ramp, go down and then go **southeast** until you find a {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door}. In the room is the resistance leader, the {creature:Renegade Orc}. Kill him.
Kill the Renegade Orc through the sealed door
There are {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and other orcs along the way.

While you are here, go and get the {item:Tome of Knowledge} on the floor below. From the ramp, go **north** to the underground entrance. On the ramp below go north and turn **west** at the first opportunity to reach the chest room. You should only meet Orc Leaders, Orc Berserkers and weaker orcs on the ramp and a lone {creature:Orc Warlord} next to the chest.
Room with the Tome of Knowledge

Go back the same way: go up the ramps to the bamboo fort, leave through the wall you broke and follow the mountain to the spot where you levitated. Go down there with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels), go down the mountain ramps to the steppe and head back **southeast** to Curos's camp.
Levitate spot (back entrance of the fort)
Last ramp in the Zao Orc Land
Go back to {npc:Curos} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. There is no reward for this mission, but you have proven your worth to the orcs.
2. Mission 2: The Maw of the Dragon
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Curos}. You have to enter the lizard tower, in the Dragonblaze Mountains, and destroy the magical spying device.
Go **north** through the small mountain cracks and find the only rope hole to the surface in the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}. Go up with the {item:Rope} **twice**.
Rope hole in the Dragonblaze Peaks
The rope hole in the Dragonblaze Peaks
{creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} can attack you from range from other mountains.

Go **southeast** and follow the mountain to the other side. Go down the ramp and go **northwest** until you find a {item:Large Hole}. Open the hole and go down. From here on you meet strong {wiki:High Class Lizards}.
Path through the Dragonblaze Peaks to the Large Hole
Go down to the tower door

Open the next hole and go down: there is 1 {creature:Lizard Legionnaire}. Kill it and go down again: there are 1 to 3 {creature:Lizard High Guard|Lizard High Guards}. Fight your way through the corridors to the stairs. Go down (there is 1 Lizard High Guard) and enter through the {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door} a little **west** of the stairs.
You are in the tower cellar. You have to climb to the top. The tower is very small and there is little room to run. Monsters per floor:
At the top of the tower, **use** the {item:Scrying Ball} to destroy it. Also open the chest next to it to receive a {item:Tome of Knowledge}.

To go back the same way, go down the tower to the cellar and leave through the sealed door. Go back through the corridors to the stairs and go up; then go up with the {item:Rope} through the holes you came down (including the {item:Large Hole}) to the surface of the Dragonblaze Peaks. Follow the mountain back **northwest** to the rope hole you came up, go down the two floors and return **south** to Curos.
Rope hole in the Dragonblaze Peaks
The monsters on each floor of the tower and the corridors may have respawned.
You can continue underground for the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} mission or go back the same way. Then say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Curos} to receive a {item:Tome of Knowledge}.

After the 2 missions you can ask {npc:Curos} for tasks: say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you a random task. Each task can be done once every **20 hours** (the counter starts when you hand it in). To hand in, say {key:hi}, {key:task} and {key:yes}.
800 exp, 650 gold and The Milkman achievement
Bring a {item:Crocodile Steak} from a {creature:Killer Caiman}
Meditate at the master's grave in the Dragonblaze Peaks
Calm a tree spirit with a {item:Wooden Flute}
Buy a {item:Bucket} from any equipment shop and {item:Milk} from a specialised food shop. Use the milk on the bucket to fill it. Take the bucket of milk to {npc:Curos}: {key:task}, {key:yes}.
800 exp, 650 gold and The Milkman achievement

Travel to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} and kill a {creature:Killer Caiman}. Use an {item:Obsidian Knife} on the corpse to get a {item:Crocodile Steak} (you may have to kill several). Take the steak to {npc:Curos}: {key:task}, {key:yes}. The {wiki:Muggy Plains} are **north** of the Dragonblaze Peaks: you get there through the old lizard teleport in the **north** of the Zao steppe, which only works after the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}. To come back, take the same route in reverse.
Go to the grave in the **north** part of the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks} (in the west area of the mountains, next to the coast) and stand on it to meditate. Then go back to {npc:Curos}: {key:task}.

Go to the infested grove to the **east** (near the coast and the mountain). Stand on the square in front of the tree spirit (with the bloodstain) and use the {item:Wooden Flute}. When you calm it, a red message appears. Go back to {npc:Curos}: {key:task}.
Square in front of the tree spirit
The infested grove with the tree spirit

You can fail: 2 {creature:Haunted Treeling|Haunted Treelings} or 2 {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas} appear. Kill them and wait for the spirit to return to its initial form before playing again. Sometimes you get Cursed for 20 turns (300 damage in total).
